RMX-913: Directional relay
The RMX-913 directional relay are designed primarily for 
use in directional phase fault. protection schemes in conjunction with either the 
definite time over current relay IKT 943 or the (e) IDMT relay IKC 913. They can 
determine the direction of all kinds of phase faults, providing the fault 
current is distinctly higher than the load current
Main Features are:
Current and voltage 
 signals evaluated digitally
Uses positive - 
 sequence components of current and voltage
Low burden
Setting for 
 characteristic angle and width of operational sector
Harmonic filters 
 incurrent and voltage inputs
Comprehensive 
 self-monitoring
Principle of Operation
The three phase-to-phase system voltages are connected to the 
two input p.t,s, the circuit, which follows derives the positive - sequence 
component u1 similarly, two phase to - phase current are obtained from the input c.t,s with their two primary windings each, and the positive sequence current 
I1, filtered out. u1, and I1, are both referred to R phase
